sources.finding: Published December 18, 2008, effective January 17, 2009; local OES occupation/skill wage methodology and other program changes.
FLS restored; the table of 2009 application-average wages is not a statutory schedule.

Pages 2 and 4: March 15 filing cutoff, June 1 normal-processing boundary, special procedures continue, and 2008-rule contracts retain the old wage principles. New contracts face other higher applicable floors.
The proposed June 29 suspension was enjoined; do not create a third implemented regime.

Archive identifies original DOL FLC wage files since FY2007 with geographic and occupational tables. Files were not downloaded: archive folder requests failed in web access and shell DNS is restricted. Generic BLS OES means/percentiles are not a verified substitute for FLC Levels I-IV.
Official page presently lists downloadable wage vintages back to 2021-2022, insufficient for the 2009 regime.

Range duty coverage, new wages and nonwage standards. Preexisting 364-day sheep/goat and ten-month other-livestock need limits retained (pages 41-42). Regulatory cost calculations and projected state floors are not observed treatment assignments.
Monthly AEWR 1206.31 from November 16, 2015 through December 31, 2016, including ongoing contracts. Competing statutory/CBA floors still apply.
Wage adjustments apply at work performance, including existing special-procedure certifications; filing-date grandfathering is invalid for the herder wage increase.
Monthly AEWR 1389.67 effective January 1, 2017, including ECI and 90-percent phase-in.
December 28, 2017 announcement corrects the 2018 floor to 1584.22, effective January 1, 2018; the original notice also printed 1548.22 in error.
Section 4(E): 2017 and 2018 sheep monthly floors exceed the national herder AEWR and differ by total employer size. H-2A certified positions do not measure total employer size.
Additional California sheep overtime phase-in begins in 2019; stop the herder response window in 2018.
June 2014 litigation is an anticipation concern; 2014 is not an assured untreated year.
